page_title: MCI 2-0 NOT | Manchester City v Nottingham Forest 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Willy Boly (Nottingham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Ederson stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
90+5' Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+3' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Phil Foden walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
85' Willy Boly (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
82' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Divock Origi (Nottingham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
81' Manchester City take a short corner kick.
78' Nathan Ake sprays a pass out to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
77' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
75' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Ola Aina and he is replaced by Divock Origi (Nottingham).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Taiwo Awoniyi as he is replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
75' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) inside the box.
73' Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) passes the ball onto Erling Haaland, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
70' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempts to find Taiwo Awoniyi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
69' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header!
65' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

64' Good defending. Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' Nottingham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
62' A long ball forward to Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is intercepted. Nottingham earn a corner.
58' The referee is firm and issues Ederson (Manchester City) a deserved yellow card.
58' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
57' A substitution has been made. Julian Alvarez goes off and Nathan Ake (Manchester City) comes on.
56' That's the end of the game for Serge Aurier, who is replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
56' Here is a change. Ibrahim Sangare is going off and Steven Cooper gives the last tactical orders to Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
54' Nottingham will take a corner kick.
51' Here comes a substitution. Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Jeremy Doku.
51' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
48' The VAR review is over and the red card for Rodri (Manchester City) stands! Off he trudges.

47' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Rodri (Manchester City), but referee Anthony Taylor must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
46' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' Rodri (Manchester City) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Nottingham are ruled offside.
45+1' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
43' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
42' The defensive wall jumps as one to block the free kick from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City).
42' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a direct free kick.
41' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Steven Cooper is forced to make a change. Nuno Tavares is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham).
38' Neat passing move from Manchester City in order to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) picks up an injury.
34' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rodri (Manchester City).
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to send the ball in.
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
28' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Matt Turner has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
24' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' This is a yellow card! Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
21' Nottingham fail to score from a corner as Ederson (Manchester City) leaps to collect the ball.

21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' Referee Anthony Taylor has finally had enough of Pep Guardiola and brandishes a yellow card at him!
19' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
18' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
17' The ratio of the ball possession is 87:13.
14' 2 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Matheus Nunes and easily beat the keeper with a header into the roof of the net from close range. 2:0.
14' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
14' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
12' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
11' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

7' 1 - 0 Goal! Kyle Walker displays great vision and sends a pass to Phil Foden (Manchester City), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
4' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the right side of the goal, but Matt Turner denies him.
3' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

2' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game. One of the players from Nottingham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Manchester City will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
